user.title: Set up House Observer
user.description: House Observer turns Home Assistant telemetry into local memory, plain-language summaries, and explainable anomaly candidates.

data_description.property_name: Used in summaries, notifications, and the observer device name.
data_description.observer_mode: Home watches for overuse, high water use, and misbehaving equipment. Rental also watches for property misuse while guests stay and for problems to fix while it is empty.

monitoring.title: What to watch
monitoring.description: Leave the pins and ignores blank to let discovery choose. You can also add the Home Assistant labels observer, observer_ignore, or observer_ followed by a category (for example observer_water) to any entity or device.

data_description.auto_discovery: Inventory eligible entities by area and let the AI provider choose a small useful set. Pins and ignores below, and the observer labels, are always applied on top.
data_description.discovery_interval_hours: Between reviews only change counts are collected. New installs are also reviewed after 1, 3, and 7 days.
data_description.always_monitor_devices: Every useful entity on these devices is monitored, whatever discovery decides.
data_description.always_monitor_entities: These entities are monitored whatever discovery decides.
data_description.never_monitor_devices: Nothing from these devices is monitored. Ignores always win.
data_description.never_monitor_entities: These entities are never monitored. Ignores always win.
data_description.occupancy_entity: A helper, binary sensor, zone, or counter that says whether the property is occupied (for example input_boolean.guest_mode or zone.home). It takes priority over stays and calendars.
data_description.reservation_entities: Calendars or sensors with booking start and end times. Only timing is used; guest names and booking IDs never reach the AI provider.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Choose an AI Task provider, or leave blank to use Home Assistant's preferred one.
data_description.observer_guidance: Property-specific priorities included with every AI summary. Clear it to remove the guidance.
data_description.summary_time: Uses Home Assistant's configured time zone.
data_description.lookback_hours: How much recent activity each scheduled summary reviews.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Start in learning-only mode until the observer has seen typical use.

data_description.learning_only: Observations and summaries are still recorded, but anomaly alerts are not sent. Recommended until baselines have formed.
data_description.notify_service: A notify entity or action, such as notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave blank to keep summaries inside Home Assistant.
data_description.notify_daily_summary: Independent of anomaly alerts and learning-only mode.

data_description.minimum_baseline_samples: A baseline must contain this many recent readings before it can flag a deviation. Baselines are kept per part of the day and older readings fade over about a month.
data_description.zscore_threshold: Higher values flag fewer deviations. The default is deliberately conservative.
data_description.retention_days: Stored observations older than this are discarded. Learned baselines and property notes are kept.
